overall_summary: High-stakes apocalyptic scenarios with explicit short time bounds (e.g., 'for 5 Seconds') and cosmic Earth alterations drive the highest retention (up to 65.02%) and view counts (up to 1,040 views). Conversely, micro-scale physical property shifts (e.g., surface tension, sand to glass) suffer rapid early drop-off within the first 3 seconds.

what_is_working.pattern: Time-bounded global cataclysms and cosmic scale shifts
what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 878 views and 65.02% average percentage watched with 39s duration. 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' reached 1,040 views.
what_is_working.action: Focus video topics on immediate, global planetary stakes paired with exact duration constraints in the title and hook.

what_to_improve.pattern: Abstract micro-physics and chemical state changes
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' collapsed to an audience watch ratio of 0.26 by 23% progress, and 'What If Water Lost All Surface Tension?' managed only 40.1% average percentage watched.
what_to_improve.action: Eliminate subtle or gradual material property transformations; replace slow setups with an immediate high-impact visual frame in the first 0.5 seconds.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' started with a 1.4176 audience watch ratio at 1% progress and maintained 0.6029 at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Structure hooks around high-stakes timers and sustain pacing with continuous visual consequences every 3 seconds.

retention_insights.drop_or_strength: Severe early drop-off in the first 5% progress
retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Rain Fell at the Speed of a Bullet?' dropped relative retention from 0.2907 at 1% progress to 0.1199 at 5% progress.
retention_insights.action: Avoid conversational intros; immediately reveal the visual transformation on screen before vocalizing the prompt.

best_posting_windows.reason: Produced top retention performer 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' at 12:08 UTC (878 views, 65.02% retention).
Generated top view counts including 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (1,040 views at 04:56 UTC) and 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' (679 views at 04:47 UTC).
